en: This research programme investigates how rules, states, and observers define descriptions of worlds.
It connects philosophical questions about existence with operational questions about prediction.
Chapters examine complexity, useful memory, causal intervention, and computational limits.
Model comparisons depend on explicit observations, resource budgets, and criteria of equivalence.
The text develops hypotheses, examples, and directions for empirical investigation.
Its central problem concerns what finite evidence can establish about apparently similar systems.
fr: Ce programme étudie les règles décrivant des mondes.
États et observateurs participent à cette description.
Complexité et mémoire rencontrent la question de la prédiction.
Les comparaisons dépendent des ressources disponibles.
L’intervention causale interroge les ressemblances observées.
Des hypothèses orientent un programme de recherche empirique.

ro: Acest program de cercetare investighează cum regulile, stările și observatorii definesc descrierile lumilor.
El leagă întrebările filosofice despre existență de întrebări operaționale despre predicție.
Capitolele examinează complexitatea, memoria utilă, intervenția cauzală și limitele calculului.
